note: #1294: a held column with neither a mapping nor an unmapped_reason would drop out of the holdings catalog unexplained (all twelve columns of two NVR tables once took fohm/nvr with them). Each such column is named; the mapped and the reasoned columns beside them, and the fully reasoned second table, are the allowed twins. The compile case unmapped-column admits a reasoned mapping-less column end to end.
fails_if: load_inventory admits a column with neither a mapping nor an unmapped_reason, or names a mapped or reasoned column beside it

message_contains: column has neither a mapping nor an unmapped_reason
